NAME:
   sdd repo - Manage connected repos for cross-repo references

USAGE:
   sdd repo [command [command options]]

COMMANDS:
   add     Connect a repo: clone it, verify its declared repo_id, register it
   list    List connected repos
   remove  Drop a declared cross-repo dependency from .sdd/config.yaml (ref-safety-guarded)
   sync    Sync connected repos (all, or the named repos) as far as the git limits allow

OPTIONS:
   --help, -h  show help
